segments.contextBefore: The object returned by the delegate method, though it may become first responder, does not become the window’s default field editor.  Other objects continue to use the window’s default field editor.
segments.contextAfter: `createFlag`: If [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), creates a field editor if one doesn’t exist; if [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false), does not create a field editor. A freshly created `NSWindow` object doesn’t have a field editor. After a field editor has been created for a window, the `createFlag` argument is ignored. By passing [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) for `createFlag` and testing the return value, however, you can predicate an action on the existence of the field editor.
